definitions.explanation: Being in a situation where one is surrounded by opposition or hostility with no allies to turn to.

examples.japanese: ⟦{社内|しゃない}→社内：13731_shanai⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{四面楚歌|しめんそか}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{状態|じょうたい}→状態：03345_joutai⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦なった→なる：01970_naru⟧。
examples.english: I found myself isolated and without allies at work.

examples.japanese: {四面楚歌|しめんそか}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{中|なか}→中：00654_naka⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦{諦|あきら}めなかった→諦める：01813_akirameru⟧。
examples.english: Even when surrounded by enemies, I didn't give up.

examples.japanese: ⟦{政権|せいけん}→政権：12883_seiken⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{四面楚歌|しめんそか}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{陥|おちい}っている→陥る：14537_ochiiru⟧。
examples.english: The administration finds itself isolated on all sides.

notes:
ETYMOLOGY:
{四面|しめん} (four sides/all directions) + {楚歌|そか} (songs of Chu)
From the story of {項羽|こうう} (Xiang Yu), a military leader in ancient China. When his army was surrounded by the forces of {劉邦|りゅうほう} (Liu Bang), he heard the songs of his native {楚|そ} (Chu) coming from the enemy camp—meaning even his own countrymen had abandoned him.

USAGE:
Describes being in a desperate situation with no support, especially when former allies have turned against you. Often used in business and political contexts.

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {四面楚歌|しめんそか}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{状態|じょうたい}→状態：03345_joutai⟧: a state of complete isolation
- {四面楚歌|しめんそか}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{陥|おちい}る→陥る：14537_ochiiru⟧: to fall into complete isolation
